item.title: 3 more outdoor NYC deaths confirmed since start of snow and frigid weather; 13 dead in all
item.description: NEW YORK, NEW YORK – JANUARY 26: A person sleeps on a sidewalk with their belongings January 26, 2026 in the Manhattan borough of New York City. New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has pledged to end sweeps of homeless encampments and plans to create a new Department of Community Safety, which will coordinate homeless outreach and respond to mental health crises.
